title: Ask for the actual local repository path before issuing YAML execution jobs
summary: Before preparing or executing a YAML-specified job that operates on an existing local Git repository, request and use the user's actual local repository filesystem path instead of assuming its location.
statement: Before preparing or executing a YAML-specified job that operates on an existing local Git repository, request and use the user's actual local repository filesystem path instead of assuming its location.

conditions: Job targets an existing explicitly authorized local repository.
exceptions: Does not authorize changing unrelated or substitute repositories.
